about: The last commits on dev of this repository: who pushed what, when, and for whom (Agent: and For: trailers), and each pair's count. Written by tools/agents-commits.mjs from git log; a snapshot as of updated (the live page reads GitHub's public API first and falls back to this). Each item: sha, at, agent, to, issue, what, served_in (the first release that served it; empty: not yet tagged when this was written), files, added, removed; its files and message are in detail-<hour>.json (detail_files). status_history: each agent's status file at every commit that changed it (asks for Dinis, last_wake, blocked). No session ids. A commit's page: https://github.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Storm-Charles/commit/<sha>.
